a1-b115: A token dose may not be enough to make the jaw release. More than once, I've dissolved Dead Sea magnesium chloride hexahydrate flakes in water and taken about one gram per minute by mouth for around twenty minutes before mine fully released. Around twenty grams is fine for my gut, and I've only had diarrhea above about forty grams. And magnesium chloride is less likely to cause diarrhea than several other kinds of magnesium, including the ones people take on purpose as laxatives. I use it mostly because it's what I know works best: it absorbs faster and better than any other form, so you can see how it's helping, usually within a minute.
asis-b120: People with impaired kidneys do need to be more cautious with large, rapid magnesium doses because they may not clear magnesium normally. But they should be far more worried about the MDMA. MDMA can cause overheating, rhabdomyolysis, dangerous electrolyte shifts, and acute kidney injury. Kidney impairment is a strong reason not to take MDMA--not a reason to sit there with worsening jaw tension after taking it. I would not tell somebody with serious kidney impairment to copy my one-gram-per-minute approach blindly; I would tell them to treat the situation as higher-risk and get help sooner.
